# CityJSON

**Maintainer ecosystem:** 3D Geoinformation Group, TU Delft / Open Geospatial Consortium (OGC) Community Standard  
**Version targeted:** 1.1 / 2.0 (LOD 2.0 building geometry)  
**Role in ARCA:** JSON-based 3D GIS exchange format export

ARCA produces CityJSON (`building.city.json`) structured as CityJSON v1.1 Building objects with LOD 2.0 Solid/MultiSurface boundaries, vertex quantization (scale & translate in millimeters), spatial hashing vertex deduplication, and EPSG:4326/CRS metadata.

ARCA does not claim ownership of the CityJSON standard or formal OGC compliance certification.
